Loading the city…

Still stuck? This is probably the project's source file, which browsers can't run.

  1. Open the game's web page (the preview link).
  2. On the main menu, click ⬇ DOWNLOAD GAME.
  3. Double-click the downloaded VOLTLINE.html. It plays offline in Chrome with nothing to install.

If the downloaded file shows a blank or black screen, turn on “Use graphics acceleration when available” in Chrome (Settings → System) and reopen it.
